show.title: David Bowie Tribute Show | STARDUST, a live, special show

show.lead: **STARDUST** is a David Bowie tribute show by six Israeli musicians. Live, kicking rock'n'roll with vocals, guitars, bass, drums, keyboards, saxophone, violin and percussion, and between the songs the story of Bowie and of the chapters of his life. A tribute, not an imitation.
facts: Vocals, guitars, bass, drums, keyboards, saxophone, violin and percussion
Four years on stage, over 70 shows in towns, live music clubs, festivals and more
Live, kicking rock'n'roll in special arrangements, with a story between the songs

sections.h2: What is a David Bowie tribute show?
body: A tribute show is a live performance devoted to one artist and his songs. Ours is **David Bowie**, the chameleon of rock, who reinvented himself again and again, from Ziggy Stardust to Blackstar. We do not try to be Bowie. We play his songs in our own arrangements, with the energy of a live rock band, and add violin, saxophone and percussion that give the songs another color.
Many tribute shows focus on recreating the sound or the look. We chose to focus on the man: what Bowie went through when he wrote each song, and how his inner world shaped the music.

sections.h2: A special show: music and story in one evening
body: Between songs we stop and tell. About the characters Bowie created and left behind, the psychology behind the changes, and the way he read himself and the world. Each song is heard as a chapter in a story, and the audience leaves not only having heard Bowie, but understanding him.
That is what turns the night from an ordinary cover show into a **special show**: songs you know, performed live and with power, and a story you have not heard.

sections.h2: From glam to Blackstar: the journey of the show
body: The show moves through Bowie's eras: the glam of Ziggy Stardust, the Berlin years, the pop of Let's Dance, and the experimental sound of his last years. Songs the band has performed include Starman, Moonage Daydream, Five Years, Ziggy Stardust, Heroes and Let's Dance.
You can read the background to each era in our guide [David Bowie: his life, eras and songs](/david-bowie/) and in [Ziggy Stardust: the album and the character](/ziggy-stardust/).

Since {{since}} we have played over 70 shows in towns, live music clubs, festivals and more, including Tel Aviv, Haifa, Jerusalem, Herzliya, Rishon LeZion, Zichron Yaakov and Kfar Saba: in bars, clubs, kibbutzim and a cinematheque. {{nextShowSentence}}
See every show on the [shows page](/shows/).

sections.h2: Want the show at your venue?
body: STARDUST plays clubs, cultural halls, festivals and corporate events. Details on the [event band page](/events/) and the [corporate events page](/corporate-events/), or write to us on WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is a David Bowie tribute show?
faq.a: A live performance devoted to his songs. STARDUST is six Israeli musicians who play Bowie's songs in their own arrangements, with violin, saxophone and percussion, and tell his story between the songs.

faq.q: Is STARDUST a cover band?
faq.a: Not exactly. A cover band plays hits. STARDUST is a tribute: devoted to one artist, with our own arrangements and a story between the songs. We do not imitate Bowie, we play and tell him.

faq.q: Who is in the band?
faq.a: Roi Isak (vocals and percussion), Guy Wittenberg (saxophone, violin and vocals), Gil Idan (drums), Dedi Kovach (keyboards and vocals), Ofer Pal (bass) and Ron Yona (guitars).

faq.q: Where has STARDUST played?
faq.a: Over 70 shows since September 2022, in towns, live music clubs, festivals and more, including Tel Aviv, Haifa, Jerusalem, Herzliya, Rishon LeZion, Zichron Yaakov and Kfar Saba, in clubs, bars, kibbutzim and a cinematheque.

faq.q: Where can I see the show?
faq.a: {{nextShowSentence}} The full list is on the shows page.

faq.q: How do I book the show?
faq.a: Write on WhatsApp or call +972 50-984-1722. We will be glad to hear about the event, the venue and the audience.

sections.h2: Cover band or tribute show: what is the difference
body: A regular cover band plays hits so that people dance. A tribute show focuses on one artist. STARDUST adds a third layer: the story. Between songs we talk about Bowie, the characters he created, and how his life shaped the music.
That is why the evening works in several kinds of places. We have played both a cinematheque and clubs, and different audiences left feeling they got something you do not hear in every cover show.

david-bowie.title: David Bowie: His Life, Eras and Songs | STARDUST
david-bowie.description: Who was David Bowie? His life, the characters he created, the eras from Ziggy Stardust to Blackstar, and the songs and albums worth knowing.
david-bowie.h1: David Bowie: who he was and the songs to know
david-bowie.lead: **David Bowie** was born David Robert Jones on 8 January 1947 in London and died on 10 January 2016, two days after his 69th birthday and the release of his last album, Blackstar. A singer, songwriter and actor, he was among the most influential artists in rock, above all for his ability to reinvent himself. STARDUST is a tribute show to him.
facts: Ziggy Stardust, Aladdin Sane, the Thin White Duke

body: Bowie started in the 1960s, broke through with Space Oddity in 1969, and for five decades changed his sound, look and persona again and again. He is known as the chameleon of rock, because every period of his career looked and sounded different.
The main facts of his life are also in the [Wikipedia entry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Bowie) and on the official site [davidbowie.com](https://www.davidbowie.com).

sections.h2: The eras and albums of David Bowie
rows: Space Oddity, Hunky Dory (Life on Mars?)
The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust, Starman, Moonage Daydream
Diamond Dogs, Young Americans (Fame), Station to Station
Scary Monsters (Ashes to Ashes), Let's Dance, Modern Love, China Girl

body: Bowie was never just music. He built characters, left them and moved on. At STARDUST we tell that story between the songs: how Bowie's inner world shaped the sound and the characters, and how he read himself and the world.
To hear it live, see the [David Bowie tribute show](/show/), and the [Ziggy Stardust guide](/ziggy-stardust/).

faq.q: When was David Bowie born and when did he die?
faq.a: David Bowie was born on 8 January 1947 in London and died on 10 January 2016 in New York, two days after the release of his last album, Blackstar.

faq.q: What are David Bowie's most important albums?
faq.a: Among the central albums: Hunky Dory, The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars, Aladdin Sane, Station to Station, Low, Heroes, Scary Monsters, Let's Dance and Blackstar.

faq.q: Who is Ziggy Stardust?
faq.a: Ziggy Stardust is a character, a rock star from another planet, that Bowie created for his 1972 album. [Read more on the Ziggy Stardust page](/ziggy-stardust/).

faq.q: Is there a David Bowie tribute show in Israel?
faq.a: Yes, STARDUST is a David Bowie tribute show by six Israeli musicians. [Details on the show page](/show/).

ziggy-stardust.title: Ziggy Stardust: David Bowie's Album, Character and Songs
ziggy-stardust.description: David Bowie's Ziggy Stardust: the story of the 1972 album, the rock star from another planet, the band behind him and the songs worth knowing.
ziggy-stardust.h1: Ziggy Stardust: the album and the character by David Bowie
ziggy-stardust.lead: **Ziggy Stardust** is the character of a rock star from another planet created by David Bowie, and the album that introduced him: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars, released in 1972. The album made Bowie a star, and our band took its name from the same dust.
facts: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars
The Spiders from Mars: Mick Ronson, Trevor Bolder, Woody Woodmansey
Five Years, Moonage Daydream, Starman, Ziggy Stardust, Suffragette City, Rock 'n' Roll Suicide

body: Ziggy Stardust is an invented rock star who arrives on Earth to bring a message of hope and falls under the weight of fame. Bowie dressed the character in bright costumes, makeup and orange hair, and performed as him on stage for about a year and a half.

The character became a symbol of theatricality and of the freedom to choose who you are. On 3 July 1973, at the Hammersmith Odeon in London, Bowie announced Ziggy's retirement and moved on to the characters that followed.

The album opens with Five Years, a song about a world that ends in five years, and moves through Moonage Daydream and Starman, among the most recognised songs in Bowie's catalogue. It closes with Rock 'n' Roll Suicide.
His backing band, The Spiders from Mars, was Mick Ronson on guitar, Trevor Bolder on bass and Woody Woodmansey on drums.

sections.h2: Ziggy Stardust and our tribute show
body: We named the band STARDUST because that dust, what Bowie left behind in every character he created and left, is what we try to bring to the stage: not the look, but the journey. Songs from this period are part of our show.
See the [David Bowie tribute show](/show/) and the [David Bowie guide](/david-bowie/).

faq.q: When was the Ziggy Stardust album released?
faq.a: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars was released in June 1972.

faq.q: Who played with Bowie on Ziggy Stardust?
faq.a: The Spiders from Mars: Mick Ronson on guitar, Trevor Bolder on bass and Woody Woodmansey on drums.

faq.q: Is the name STARDUST related to Ziggy Stardust?
faq.a: Yes. We chose the name inspired by the dust Bowie left behind in every character, Ziggy Stardust first among them.

about.title: About the Band: STARDUST, a David Bowie Tribute Show
about.description: Meet STARDUST, a David Bowie tribute show: six Israeli musicians from bands such as Susita, Portrait, Alila and King George, four years on stage.
about.lead: **STARDUST** is a band of six Israeli musicians united by love for the music of David Bowie. We have performed for four years, playing a tribute, not an imitation, and telling his story between the songs. The band used to perform as YADAYADAS, and changed its name to STARDUST in 2026.

body: We began as a group of musicians united by a love of Bowie, who wanted to make a tribute and not an imitation: with violin, saxophone and percussion, and with a story. Since {{since}} we have played over 70 shows in towns, live music clubs, festivals and more.
In 2026 we changed the name from YADAYADAS to STARDUST, because the new name says simply what we do on stage. The band and the music stayed the same.
Details on the [event band page](/events/) and the [corporate events page](/corporate-events/), or write to us on WhatsApp.

faq.a: Roi Isak (vocals and percussion), Guy Wittenberg (saxophone, violin and vocals), Gil Idan (drums), Dedi Kovach (keyboards and vocals), Ofer Pal (bass) and Ron Yona (guitars).

faq.q: What is the connection between STARDUST and YADAYADAS?
faq.a: They are the same band. It used to perform as YADAYADAS and changed its name to STARDUST in 2026.
